catalog.description: a drive degrades against its peers at equal current (winding or vibration residual); the cause is not told yet: neither the bearing rule nor the gearbox rule holds. bearing and gearbox_seizing refine it

a dry drive bearing: the drive's 15 minute vibration mean is at least 0.3 mm/s above the larger of its peers' (each window holding at least 14 of its 15 readings); its winding temperature rises with it at equal current

a drive gearbox losing oil, which will seize and drag the belt: in the same minute its 30 minute winding slope is at least 2 K/h above the larger of its peers' (each holding at least 162 of its 180 readings) while its vibration mean is less than 0.05 mm/s above theirs; stop the empty belt rather than the drive
a drive stopped carrying load while the feed is high
a rise every drive shares, such as a feed surge, or a short dip that recovers on its own

objective:
One conveyor drive degrades against its peers at equal current. Give the
diagnosis by the catalog's rules and request the one step of the
situation's phase. drive_degrading is the diagnosis of a drive that
degrades while neither the bearing rule nor the gearbox rule holds; bearing
and gearbox_seizing refine it once their rule holds. The phase, not the
cause, decides the step: an untold cause is no reason to wait, and a watch
never replaces the step of a phase that has one. Never act on a rise every
drive shares.
- phase degrading: shed the feed to the plant's limp feed - intent
  reduce_feed (preset limp), with the diagnosis drive_degrading, or the
  cause when its rule already holds.
- phase shedding: run the belt empty by stopping the feeder - intent
  stop_feed (preset empty), with the diagnosis drive_degrading, or the
  cause when its rule already holds. Do not shed the feed again.
- phase belt_empty: no step; the evidence has not named the cause yet.
- phase cause_bearing: stop the degraded drive by plan - intent
  isolate_drive (preset planned_stop).
- phase cause_gearbox: stop the empty belt before the gearbox seizes -
  intent stop_belt (preset planned_stop).
- phase cause_undecided: stop the empty belt, the safe default - intent
  stop_belt (preset planned_stop).
- phase isolated: restore the plant's limp feed - intent reduce_feed
  (preset limp). The drive was isolated because its bearing rule held:
  give the diagnosis bearing, although the stopped drive no longer
  vibrates.
Decide whether the conveyor lost a drive while the feed is high and name
the drive whose current fell to about 0 A. Request the one step of the
situation's phase; never stop the belt.
- phase overload: cut the feed to the limp feed the two survivors carry -
  intent reduce_feed (preset limp).
prompt: Analyze the immutable snapshot (each drive's current, its vibration and winding temperature over 15 minutes, the degraded drive's winding slope, the feed, its setpoint and the belt speed) and return a typed decision with a diagnosis and at most one request for the phase's step.

watch_preset.expression:
cel.bind(bearing_vibration_mm_s, 0.3, cel.bind(gearbox_slope_k_per_h, 2.0, cel.bind(gearbox_quiet_vibration_mm_s, 0.05, cel.bind(vibration_readings_15m, 14.0, cel.bind(slope_readings_30m, 162.0, cel.bind(peer_vibration, features.drive1_vibration_15m > features.drive2_vibration_15m ? features.drive1_vibration_15m : features.drive2_vibration_15m, cel.bind(peer_slope, features.drive1_winding_slope_30m > features.drive2_winding_slope_30m ? features.drive1_winding_slope_30m : features.drive2_winding_slope_30m, cel.bind(vibration_counted, features.drive1_vibration_readings_15m >= vibration_readings_15m && features.drive2_vibration_readings_15m >= vibration_readings_15m && features.drive3_vibration_readings_15m >= vibration_readings_15m, cel.bind(slope_counted, features.drive1_winding_readings_30m >= slope_readings_30m && features.drive2_winding_readings_30m >= slope_readings_30m && features.drive3_winding_readings_30m >= slope_readings_30m,
  vibration_counted && (features.drive3_vibration_15m - peer_vibration >= bearing_vibration_mm_s ||
    slope_counted && features.drive3_winding_slope_30m - peer_slope >= gearbox_slope_k_per_h && features.drive3_vibration_15m - peer_vibration < gearbox_quiet_vibration_mm_s))))))))))
